senses.gloss: f., (קָפָה) a stiff mass of grist, oil and onions.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 2:9">Succ. II, 9</cite> <he>משתסרח המ׳</he> when a stiff dish gets spoiled.
<cite ref="Sukkah 29a:3">Ib. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של גריסין</he> a pulp of grist; Y. ib. II, end, 53ᵇ <he>מִקְפַּת גריסין</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 29a">Ib.</cite> <he>מכפה של כל דבר</he> (corr. acc.) a pulp of anything; a. fr.
